Hi Vijayan

Please find answers below.

Le 10. 06. 14 16:58, Vijayan Thankappan a écrit :
Hello Friends
 I am estimating a threshold vector autoregression (TVAR)  model for bivariate case. I  have the following questions. I appreciate any help to answer them:

1. In tsDyn we have the TVAR command, and also a setar command. Is there any difference between the two?
well setar is univariate!
2. In setar, we can have different lags in each regime using the mL, mH, and mM options, but TVAR does not have it. Am I right?
you are right, TVAr does not have
3. In TVAR, what is the mTh option? Is it like the delay parameter?
in TVAR, you input two variables (at least) so mTh tells which one will be the transition variable



Thanks, and Best wishes,

Vijayan
